title: The Last Clock
author: B. M. Nystrom
blurb: Bram Ashgrove, a widowed lighthouse keeper during the year of the great storms, has spent fifteen years learning which silences keep people safe. Then a sealed letter names the family in a plot no one wants a part of — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must finish the work while the workshop still stands, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
